description: Engineering backlog worked by the autonomous agent (scripts/agent/run.mjs), one task per run. Statuses: pending | done | blocked. Add tasks freely; the agent picks the first pending task whose dependsOn are all done.

tasks.title: Centralized error handling with AppError and 404 handler
tasks.description: Introduce an AppError class (status, message, optional details) in src/utils/AppError.js and a central error middleware in src/middleware/errorHandler.js. Add a notFound middleware for unknown routes. Wire both in createApp, replacing the inline error handler. Unexpected errors must return a generic 500 without leaking err.message.
acceptanceCriteria: Unknown routes return 404 { error: 'Not found' }
Thrown AppError(409, 'x') returns 409 { error: 'x' } (and details when provided)
Unexpected errors return 500 { error: 'Internal server error' } and do NOT include the original error message
Malformed JSON bodies return 400 instead of 500

tasks.title: Validate registration input with zod
tasks.description: Add a reusable validate(schema) middleware (src/middleware/validate.js) and a registration schema (src/validators/userValidators.js). Username 3-50 chars [a-zA-Z0-9_], valid email (normalized to lowercase), password 8-128 chars with at least one letter and one number. Apply to POST /api/users/register.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid payloads return 400 { error: 'Validation failed', details: [{ field, message }] }
No database query is issued for invalid payloads
Email is lowercased before the uniqueness check and insert
Valid payloads still register successfully

tasks.title: JWT login endpoint
tasks.description: Add POST /api/users/login accepting { email, password }. Verify with bcrypt, issue an HS256 JWT (sub = user id, username claim, 1h expiry) signed with process.env.JWT_SECRET. Put token logic in src/services/tokenService.js. Validate input with the existing validate middleware.
acceptanceCriteria: Correct credentials return 200 { token, user } without the password hash
Wrong password and unknown email both return 401 with the same generic message (no user enumeration)
Token verifies with JWT_SECRET and has sub, username and exp claims
Missing JWT_SECRET causes a 500, never an unsigned or default-secret token

tasks.title: requireAuth middleware and GET /api/users/me
tasks.description: Add src/middleware/requireAuth.js that verifies 'Authorization: Bearer <jwt>' using tokenService and sets req.user = { id, username }. Add GET /api/users/me returning the current user from the database.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing, malformed, expired or wrongly-signed tokens return 401
Valid token sets req.user and /me returns { user } from the DB
/me returns 404 if the user no longer exists

tasks.title: Create auctions (POST /api/auctions)
tasks.description: Add an auctions router/controller. POST /api/auctions (requireAuth) with { title, description?, startPrice, endsAt }. Validate: title 3-100 chars, startPrice > 0 with max 2 decimals, endsAt ISO date at least 1 minute in the future. Insert with seller_id = req.user.id, current_price = start_price, status 'ACTIVE'. Mount at /api/auctions.
acceptanceCriteria: 201 { auction } with camelCase fields on success
401 without a token, 400 with field details on invalid input
INSERT is parameterized and uses the authenticated user as seller

tasks.title: List and fetch auctions with pagination
tasks.description: GET /api/auctions with ?status=ACTIVE|PENDING|CLOSED, ?limit (1-100, default 20) and ?cursor (id-based keyset pagination, ordered by id DESC). GET /api/auctions/:id returns one auction. Both public.
acceptanceCriteria: List returns { auctions, pagination: { nextCursor } } and nextCursor is null on the last page
Invalid status/limit/cursor returns 400
Unknown or non-numeric id returns 404 / 400 respectively
Pagination uses WHERE id < $cursor, not OFFSET

tasks.title: Place bids with row-level locking
tasks.description: Add a bids table to schema.sql (id, auction_id FK, bidder_id FK, amount NUMERIC(12,2), created_at; index on (auction_id, amount DESC)). POST /api/auctions/:id/bids (requireAuth) { amount }. In ONE transaction: SELECT the auction FOR UPDATE, reject if not ACTIVE or ends_at passed (409), reject seller bidding on own auction (403), require amount >= current_price + minimum increment (max(1.00, 5% of current_price)) else 409, insert bid, update current_price, COMMIT. ROLLBACK on any error and always release the client.
acceptanceCriteria: Uses db.connect(), BEGIN, SELECT ... FOR UPDATE, COMMIT; ROLLBACK on every failure path
Client is released on success and on failure
Correct status codes for closed auction, own auction, too-low bid, unknown auction
201 { bid, auction: { currentPrice } } on success

tasks.title: Bid history endpoint
tasks.description: GET /api/auctions/:id/bids returning bids newest first with bidder username (JOIN users), limit 1-100 default 50, plus the current highest bid.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns { bids, highestBid } with no user emails or hashes
404 for unknown auction, 400 for invalid id/limit

tasks.title: Token-bucket rate limiter for auth and bidding
tasks.description: Implement an in-memory token bucket in src/middleware/rateLimit.js (no dependencies): createRateLimiter({ capacity, refillPerSecond, key: req => string, now?: () => ms }). Apply to POST /login (by IP) and POST bids (by user id). Inject `now` so tests are deterministic without sleeping.
acceptanceCriteria: Requests beyond capacity get 429 with a Retry-After header
Tokens refill over time (tested via injected clock)
Buckets are independent per key
Stale buckets are evicted so memory does not grow unbounded

tasks.title: Request IDs and structured access logs
tasks.description: Middleware that assigns each request an id (honor an incoming X-Request-Id if it is a safe <=64 char token, else crypto.randomUUID()), echoes it in the X-Request-Id response header, and logs one JSON line per request on finish: { requestId, method, path, status, durationMs }. Include requestId in 500 error responses.
acceptanceCriteria: Every response has X-Request-Id
Unsafe incoming ids are replaced
One JSON log line per request with the documented fields
500 responses include requestId

tasks.title: Close expired auctions
tasks.description: Add src/services/auctionCloser.js exporting closeExpiredAuctions({ db, now }) that, in a transaction, marks ACTIVE auctions with ends_at <= now as CLOSED and returns [{ auctionId, winnerId, winningAmount }] using the highest bid (or null winner). Add POST /api/admin/auctions/close-expired protected by an X-Admin-Token header compared with crypto.timingSafeEqual against process.env.ADMIN_TOKEN.
acceptanceCriteria: Only ACTIVE + expired auctions are closed (verified via SQL params)
Winner is the highest bidder; auctions without bids close with winnerId null
Admin endpoint returns 401 for missing/wrong token, uses timingSafeEqual
Transaction is rolled back on error

tasks.title: Liveness vs readiness probes
tasks.description: Keep GET /health as liveness. Add GET /health/ready that returns 200 when SELECT 1 succeeds within 1 second and 503 otherwise (use Promise.race with a timer that is cleared). Kubernetes-style.
acceptanceCriteria: /health/ready returns 200 when the DB responds and 503 when it errors
A DB call that never resolves yields 503 within ~1s and leaves no dangling timer
Existing /health behavior unchanged

tasks.title: Security headers middleware (no dependencies)
tasks.description: Add src/middleware/securityHeaders.js and mount it first in createApp. Set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, Referrer-Policy: no-referrer, Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin, and a strict Content-Security-Policy (default-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'). Disable Express's X-Powered-By header.
acceptanceCriteria: Every response (including 404 and errors) carries the listed headers
X-Powered-By is absent
No new npm dependencies

tasks.title: Request body size limit returns 413
tasks.description: Configure express.json with a 100kb limit (overridable via createApp({ bodyLimit })). The central error handler must map body-parser's 'entity.too.large' error (err.type === 'entity.too.large' or err.status === 413) to 413 { error: 'Payload too large' }.
acceptanceCriteria: Bodies over the limit return 413 { error: 'Payload too large' }, not 500
Bodies under the limit still work
Malformed JSON still returns 400

tasks.title: CORS allow-list middleware (no dependencies)
tasks.description: Add src/middleware/cors.js: createCors({ origins }) where origins comes from process.env.CORS_ORIGINS (comma-separated) by default. For allowed origins set Access-Control-Allow-Origin to the exact origin, Vary: Origin, and allow methods GET,POST,PATCH,DELETE,OPTIONS and headers Content-Type,Authorization. Answer preflight OPTIONS with 204. Never send '*' together with credentials.
acceptanceCriteria: Allowed origin gets the CORS headers and Vary: Origin
Disallowed or missing origin gets no Access-Control-Allow-Origin
OPTIONS preflight from an allowed origin returns 204
Origins list is injectable for tests

tasks.title: Validated environment configuration
tasks.description: Add src/config/env.js exporting loadConfig(env = process.env) that validates with zod: PORT (default 5001), DB_* fields, JWT_SECRET (min 32 chars outside NODE_ENV=test), CORS_ORIGINS (optional), ADMIN_TOKEN (optional). Returns a frozen typed object; throws one readable error listing every invalid variable. Do not change server startup behavior in tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid env returns a frozen config with defaults applied
Invalid env throws a single error naming every bad variable
Short JWT_SECRET is rejected unless NODE_ENV=test
Secrets never appear in the error message

tasks.title: Graceful shutdown helper
tasks.description: Add src/utils/shutdown.js exporting createShutdown({ server, db, timeoutMs = 10000, logger = console }) that returns an idempotent async shutdown(signal): stop accepting connections (server.close), then db.end(), resolving when both finish or rejecting after timeoutMs. Wire SIGTERM/SIGINT in server.js only. Test with fake server/db objects.
acceptanceCriteria: Calls server.close then db.end exactly once even if invoked twice
Times out with a clear error if close hangs (tested with a short timeout)
server.js registers SIGTERM and SIGINT handlers

tasks.title: Public user profile endpoint
tasks.description: GET /api/users/:id returns { user: { id, username, createdAt, auctionCount } } using a single parameterized query (LEFT JOIN or subquery on auctions). Never return email or password. Validate :id with validate(schema, 'params').
acceptanceCriteria: Returns public fields only (no email/password)
400 for non-numeric id, 404 for unknown user
auctionCount computed in SQL

tasks.title: Update own profile (PATCH /api/users/me)
tasks.description: PATCH /api/users/me (requireAuth) accepts { username?, email? } (at least one), validated like registration (email lowercased). Reject if the new username/email belongs to another user (409). Return the updated user without password.
acceptanceCriteria: 401 without token, 400 for empty or invalid body
409 when username/email is taken by another user
200 { user } with updated fields; UPDATE is parameterized and scoped to req.user.id

tasks.title: Change password endpoint
tasks.description: POST /api/users/me/password (requireAuth) with { currentPassword, newPassword }. Verify current password with bcrypt, enforce the registration password rules on newPassword, reject newPassword equal to current, store a new bcrypt hash (cost 10).
acceptanceCriteria: 401 without token; 401 when currentPassword is wrong
400 for weak or unchanged new password
204 on success and the stored value is a bcrypt hash of newPassword
Password hashes never appear in responses

tasks.title: List my auctions (GET /api/users/me/auctions)
tasks.description: GET /api/users/me/auctions (requireAuth) lists auctions where seller_id = req.user.id, optional ?status filter, keyset pagination like GET /api/auctions (limit 1-100 default 20, cursor = last id, ordered by id DESC).
acceptanceCriteria: Only the caller's auctions are returned (seller_id bound to req.user.id)
Returns { auctions, pagination: { nextCursor } }
401 without token, 400 for invalid query

tasks.title: Seller can edit an auction before bidding
tasks.description: PATCH /api/auctions/:id (requireAuth) lets the seller update title, description and endsAt (must stay at least 1 minute in the future). Only allowed while status is PENDING or ACTIVE and there are no bids yet; otherwise 409. Non-sellers get 403.
acceptanceCriteria: 403 for non-seller, 404 for unknown auction
409 if the auction has bids or is CLOSED
400 for invalid fields; 200 { auction } on success
UPDATE is parameterized and includes the seller check

tasks.title: Search auctions by title
tasks.description: Extend GET /api/auctions with optional ?q (1-100 chars). Match title case-insensitively with ILIKE using a parameter, escaping %, _ and \ in user input so they are matched literally. Combine with existing status filter and pagination.
acceptanceCriteria: ?q is passed as a bound parameter, never interpolated
%, _ and \ in q are escaped
Works together with status and cursor pagination
400 for q longer than 100 chars

tasks.title: List my bids (GET /api/users/me/bids)
tasks.description: GET /api/users/me/bids (requireAuth) returns the caller's bids newest first with auction id, title, current price and whether the caller is currently the highest bidder (computed in SQL). Pagination limit 1-100 default 50, cursor = last bid id.
acceptanceCriteria: Only bids where bidder_id = req.user.id
Each item includes isWinning computed in SQL
401 without token, 400 for invalid query

tasks.title: Auction watchlist
tasks.description: Add a watchlist table to schema.sql (user_id FK, auction_id FK, created_at, PRIMARY KEY (user_id, auction_id)). Endpoints (requireAuth): POST /api/watchlist/:auctionId (idempotent, 201 or 200 if already present), DELETE /api/watchlist/:auctionId (204), GET /api/watchlist (auctions the user watches, newest first). Use INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING.
acceptanceCriteria: Schema change is idempotent (IF NOT EXISTS)
Adding twice does not duplicate (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING)
404 when the auction does not exist
All queries scoped to req.user.id

tasks.title: Analytics: most active auctions
tasks.description: GET /api/analytics/top-auctions?window=24h|7d|30d&limit=1-50 (default 7d, 10) returns auctions ranked by bid count in the window with bidCount, uniqueBidders and currentPrice, computed in one SQL query with GROUP BY. Window maps to a fixed interval whitelist (never interpolate user input).
acceptanceCriteria: Single parameterized aggregate query; window mapped through a whitelist
Returns { auctions: [{ id, title, bidCount, uniqueBidders, currentPrice }] }
400 for invalid window or limit

tasks.title: Serve an OpenAPI 3.1 description of the API
tasks.description: Add src/docs/openapi.js exporting a plain-object OpenAPI 3.1 document describing every route currently mounted in createApp (paths, methods, auth requirement via bearerAuth, request bodies, main responses), and serve it at GET /api/openapi.json. Add a test that walks the Express router stack and fails if any mounted route is missing from the document.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/openapi.json returns valid JSON with openapi: '3.1.0'
Every mounted route+method appears in paths (enforced by a test)
Protected routes declare bearerAuth security
